items.claim: Scene tab recursed forever after a node was moved under one of its own former children
Trace records over the serializer's 100-item cap crashed the Dispatch tab when expanded
Frame tab threw on a canvas with more than 100 render layers
History tab's Age column stopped counting between history notices
Coord table's Scale column dropped `scaleY` and the view's offset
One trace detail spelled the same key three different ways
Frame tab showed the last frame again after the fps overlay was turned off and back on
Frame tab showed the "fps overlay is off" note in place of a get-state error
Dispatch tab's Clear left the coord rows, and was disabled when only coord rows existed
Dispatch diagram showed a blank Route cell for a binding with no route form
Each trace notice queued one more serial read behind a slow transport, in the Dispatch and History tabs
Overlay sweep loses later steps, because each is diffed against a stale render
Key route `*` drawn as the asterisk key, and optional modifiers in the arg dropped
items.note: This adds `foldKeyRoute` to `@weasel-js/gestures`, so `describeRoute` and the strip read a key arg through one function.

items.claim: Overlay flags and probes go stale in the State and Frame tabs
items.note: Both tabs now poll `get-state` every 500 ms while open.

items.claim: Hover route's `held` slot not drawn
Route the grammar rejects throws during render and unmounts the panel
items.note: The strip falls back to the raw route text.

items.claim: A dep's "Required by" leaves out tools that declare it
items.note: `tool.deps` holds the deps a tool *registers* (`protocol.ts:128`, "Names of the deps it registers"), so a tool supplies the dep rather than requiring it.

items.claim: CoordTable padding collapses in HTML
items.note: The padding is U+2007 figure spaces, which HTML does not collapse, and the x/y separator is a single plain space.

items.claim: CoordTable rows keyed by their index in the window remount every poll
items.note: This adds `TraceRead.coordCursor`, with a minor changeset, so rows are keyed by their place in the canvas's ring.

items.claim: ValueView gives an object's own `…` key and its "N more" row the same React key
RegistryBrowser leaf keys collide on ids containing `/`
A route the panel's grammar can't parse throws during render and takes down the whole tab
GestureRoute drops a route's `held` requirement, so `hover +held` draws the same as plain `hover`
State tab's tool picker never re-reads when tools register or unregister
Frame and State tabs never notice overlay flags that the page itself changes
CoordTable's Scale column shows only scaleX, so a non-uniform view scale is misreported
Dispatch tab's Clear leaves the coord records behind
HistoryTable's row click "expands" rows that have nothing to expand, collapsing the open one
The Registry tab never re-reads on a tool or view change, so `enabled` and `active` go stale
CoordTable's space-padded figures collapse in HTML, so its coordinate columns don't line up
FallthroughDiagram's `.srOnly` text has no positioned ancestor, so it escapes the scrolling stage
RegistryBrowser ignores typing when a caller passes `onFilterChange` without `filter`
RegistryBrowser's leaf keys collide across categories whose ids contain `/`
useSceneTree never removes deleted nodes from `expanded`, and re-requests each one on every scene change
ValueView gives an object's own `…` key and its "more" row the same React key
